title: Sea of Chaos: Plunder
tagline: Sink rivals, steal their gold and bank it before you sink. Fast pirate brawls for 1v1 to 3v3.

roles.name: Captain
roles.description: Practice against bots, or host/join a crew battle with a 4-letter room code.

multiplayer.notes: Three-minute matches. Scoop floating treasure, bank it at your harbor, and sink rivals to spill the gold they carry. A treasure galleon crosses the sea twice; banked gold counts double in the last 30 seconds. Most banked gold wins. Bots fill empty berths. Host simulation 30Hz, snapshots 10Hz, controls 20Hz.

requires: keyboard and mouse or touch controls
